You are predicting whether an article published by Mashable becomes popular: shared 1,400 times or more. The data are real statistics of Mashable articles from 2013 and 2014 (the UCI Online News Popularity dataset; the text itself is not included). Each article is one line of values, in this order:
1. n_tokens_title: words in the title
2. n_tokens_content: words in the article
3. n_unique_tokens: share of the words that are unique
4. n_non_stop_words: share of non-stop words
5. n_non_stop_unique_tokens: share of unique non-stop words
6. average_token_length: average word length
7. num_imgs: images
8. num_videos: videos
9. num_hrefs: links
10. num_self_hrefs: links to other Mashable articles
11. self_reference_min_shares: fewest shares of a Mashable article it links to
12. self_reference_max_shares: most shares of a Mashable article it links to
13. self_reference_avg_sharess: average shares of the Mashable articles it links to
14. num_keywords: keywords in its metadata
15. kw_min_min: worst keyword: fewest shares
16. kw_max_min: worst keyword: most shares
17. kw_avg_min: worst keyword: average shares
18. kw_min_max: best keyword: fewest shares
19. kw_max_max: best keyword: most shares
20. kw_avg_max: best keyword: average shares
21. kw_min_avg: average keyword: fewest shares
22. kw_max_avg: average keyword: most shares
23. kw_avg_avg: average keyword: average shares
24. weekday: day published
25. data_channel_is_lifestyle: 1 = Lifestyle channel
26. data_channel_is_entertainment: 1 = Entertainment channel
27. data_channel_is_bus: 1 = Business channel
28. data_channel_is_socmed: 1 = Social Media channel
29. data_channel_is_tech: 1 = Tech channel
30. data_channel_is_world: 1 = World channel
31. LDA_00: closeness to topic 0 (of five topics found by LDA)
32. LDA_01: closeness to topic 1
33. LDA_02: closeness to topic 2
34. LDA_03: closeness to topic 3
35. LDA_04: closeness to topic 4
36. title_subjectivity: title subjectivity (0–1)
37. title_sentiment_polarity: title polarity (−1 to 1)
38. abs_title_subjectivity: how far the title’s subjectivity is from neutral
39. abs_title_sentiment_polarity: title polarity, unsigned
40. global_subjectivity: article subjectivity (0–1)
41. global_sentiment_polarity: article polarity (−1 to 1)
42. global_rate_positive_words: share of positive words
43. global_rate_negative_words: share of negative words
44. rate_positive_words: positive words among the non-neutral
45. rate_negative_words: negative words among the non-neutral
46. avg_positive_polarity: average polarity of its positive words
47. min_positive_polarity: least positive word
48. max_positive_polarity: most positive word
49. avg_negative_polarity: average polarity of its negative words
50. min_negative_polarity: most negative word
51. max_negative_polarity: least negative word
